# Scope and ownership
Planning only for `lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channel_history_live.ex`, missed 1-based lines 77, 81, 89, 101, 109, 115, 127, 145-147, 152, 154, 156, 165, 183, 187, 201, 206, 211, 227, 231, 243-244, 249-250. Exclusive implementation test path: `test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channel_history_live_test.exs` (edit existing; no other test files, production files, documentation or E2E specs in this slice). Existing tests already establish real admin/Engine routing, canonical history and ratings; do not duplicate them merely for a line counter. Do not change production code for test seams. `ChannelHistoryLive` owns BO presentation/event dispatch, not permission or membership operations; retain Engine verification through confidential `%Zaq.Event{}` and `NodeRouter.dispatch/1`.

# Prerequisites and test-first setup
Start from existing `ZaqWeb.ConnCase, async: false`, `super_admin_fixture`, password/session setup, `People.create_person`, `ChannelConfig.changeset` + Repo insert, `Facts.new`/`Conversations.capture_canonical_message` and `HistoryIngress.capture`. Extract a tiny locally scoped fixture only if repetition warrants it: create a named, enabled Mattermost connector and a shared root transcript from a valid `Incoming` (`routing_context: %{channel_config_id: config.id, conversation_type: :room}`), with optional thread; return concrete config/transcript/message IDs. Reuse existing fixture examples in this test, `test/zaq/engine/channel_history_admin_test.exs`, and `test/zaq/channels/mattermost_shared_history_integration_test.exs`. Choose unique room IDs and people; use real BO login and real NodeRouter/Engine/DB; assert observable HTML/flash, `has_element?`, exact returned event or `assert_push_event`, persisted grants/ratings; no introspection of private helpers or sleeps. Use `render_hook/3` only for forged/invalid events not generated by HTML controls; document why each is useful for server-side fail-closed protection. For local provider HTTP, reuse `Zaq.TestSupport.OpenAIStub.server` with a dedicated Mattermost response callback (or `MattermostHistoryFixture.http` if it exactly matches); `start_supervised!` the per-test server and point connector URL at it. Do not use public network, global NodeRouter stubs, globally registered mocks, or global application env mutations. If the transport fixture genuinely requires unavoidable global env, put that particular case in a separate `async: false` module in the same exclusive test file and restore every changed key with `on_exit/1`; the existing module is already `async: false` but that alone does not protect other async tests. Sandbox ownership for any spawned server/client must be explicit where it performs DB reads; HTTP fixture should not query Repo.

# Tests to write before any production change (none planned)
A. List filter (77,81): after inserting two distinctly named transcripts, `form(view, "#channel-history-filter", filter: %{query: "ENG"}) |> render_change()` keeps matching room/connector only (case-insensitive), then unmatched query shows empty state. Submit >100 characters and assert input value is the first 100 characters; use a forged `render_hook(view, "filter", %{})` or non-binary query to assert unchanged filter/list. Ensure no server query/search widened beyond the loaded page; no duplicate list rows.
B. Clipboard and info (89,101,211): on real detail, trigger copy action and `assert_push_event(view, "clipboard", %{text: exact_content})`; if the component does not expose a clickable copy control, `render_hook` with the actual text tests the LiveView event. Open valid assistant info via existing button; reopen after invalid UUID or message ID from a different transcript and assert exact error flash, no foreign message details, and prior info not overwritten. On list/error detail where no valid transcript is assigned, forge `open_message_info` and `feedback` to exercise `message_request/2` fallback (211), assert unavailable/save-error flash and no unauthorized info/rating write; cover successful info branch via existing test rather than re-implement it.
C. Trace (109,115): arrange an actual assistant message with a permitted persisted trace entry in its private message metadata; open message info, click its actual `toggle_trace` control, assert trace detail opens and closes on the second click and switching message resets expanded state. Check message-info projection/ChatMessage popin trace schema before arranging data; if canonical capture cannot persist trace via a production path, use a minimal test DB fixture for already-persisted private metadata (not a production hook) and state why. If the template has no toggle for the permitted projection, report the UI branch as unreachably rendered; do not assert private socket MapSet purely to win coverage.
D. Feedback failure (127): on a real assistant message, forge `feedback` with valid `type` but a message UUID from a different transcript or nonexistent UUID; assert `Could not save feedback`, original rating unchanged, and no detail replacement. Both types' successful mapping to 5/1 already tested in existing suite.
E. Refresh (145,146,147,152,154,156,165): one shared Mattermost transcript with a valid 26-lowercase-alphanumeric room ID (not `room-1`: `MattermostAdmin.room_capabilities/2` rejects it), so Engine projects `refresh_supported?: true`. For success, serve complete local `/api/v4/channels/<id>/members` snapshot with known channel-identified Person; click refresh in access modal and assert exact `Provider access refreshed (N linked People)` flash, reloaded detail/grant source, and expected persisted provider read grant, preserving an independent manual grant. For failure, have the same local endpoint reply failure or incomplete response; assert exact unchanged flash and unchanged persisted grants (no partial snapshot). Use existing fixture callback expectations for path/query and captured request, not live external HTTP. For unsupported transcript (e.g. direct/replicated or invalid Mattermost ID), forge refresh if button is absent and assert unsupported flash and no provider request. Forge refresh on list or unavailable-detail state to assert no-op (165) and no mutation. The line 146 dispatch and 152 detail reload are covered by success; 145 by supported branch; 147 and 154 by success; 156 by failure.
F. Grant/revoke validation and guards (183,187,201,206): on real shared/direct detail submit `grant` IDs `"0"`, `"-1"`, `"12junk"`, empty and non-string (forged events for browser-impossible types), asserting `Could not update manual access`, no grant and no unintended Person ID. Existing valid grant/revoke success already exercises dispatch and detail reload; additionally grant nonexistent positive ID to exercise Engine error and line 201, asserting no grant and error flash. Forge grant and revoke on list/invalid-detail state to hit 206 and assert no flash/side effect. Do not permit absent Person/nil to grant access; never bypass Engine admin or Person checks.
G. Cursor and pagination (227,231,243,244): navigate `?offset=-1`, `?offset=abc`, `?offset[]=1` (only if Plug/Phoenix accepts list query without rejecting route) and analogous `?after=abc`, asserting sanitized History/Transcript unavailable response rather than server crash or leaked data. `?after=0junk` hits partial parse rejection (227); non-binary `offset`/`after` params from decoded structured query hit 231 only if LiveView receives them (check route/Plug behavior; otherwise unreachable from HTTP, no invented private API). Build exactly 50 authorized canonical messages on one transcript to reveal `Next 50 messages`; click and assert href/patch `after=<50th position>` and subsequent page contains only the next message when 51 exist (244). Empty `next_cursor([])` at 243 is structurally unreachable through template: button is emitted only when `length(messages) == 50`; do not export private helper or change production for artificial coverage. Record as blocked/unreachable unless a genuine production path appears.
H. Thread root previews (249,250): create thread with missing root (`thread_id` references nonexisting parent message) and list parent threads; assert `Root message unavailable` in thread row/breadcrumb if projection retains that row. Create thread whose root has nil/empty content and a valid attachment descriptor, assert `Attachment` preview. Verify `root_message` projection and capture schema first; if `nil` preview is supplied as no root use 249, and only map `%{content: nil | ""}` reaches 250. Avoid forcing malformed message structs through fake NodeRouter just to color lines.

# Property assessment, validation and blockers
No new property in this slice: the UI dispatch and finite cursor/error examples are not a broad new invariant; canonical authorization, ordering and membership normalization are Engine-owned and tested in their own suites. If analysis uncovers a changed broad permission/default invariant, add a focused Engine property in its separate owner issue, not this exclusive test path. Do not add E2E: this is regression coverage of existing BO UI, no new journey; human UX/UI E2E authoring gate not triggered. Action reuse: not applicable; only tests of existing `channel_history_admin` Event and Engine/Channels operations, no new executable operation or tool exposure. No docs update expected (test-only work); if a real behavior gap is found, stop and file a separate owner-domain issue rather than altering production in this ticket. Validation for implementing agent (not run during planning): targeted `mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channel_history_live_test.exs`, `mix q` through Context Mode, fresh `mix coveralls.json` and `mix coverup` only at post-review coverage gate with 600000 ms budget, inspect relevant whole-file missed-line report and document infeasible lines; final `mix precommit` with 900000 ms budget before asking for approval per workflow. On failure, diagnose and re-run, never weaken existing assertions. Coverage target >=95% when attainable; log exceptions with evidence rather than artificial tests. No code, test, validation or Git mutations are authorized in this planning handoff.
